title: New Orleans style versus Mobile ragtime
summary: New Orleans bands played original jazz while Mobile played strictly by music; their visits hurt local business. Pope never went to New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Yes, sir. I wondered, the dance bands you heard, like Sam Morgan and the other ones that came over from New Orleans, did they have a different style of music than the local people played?
Yes, they did. They had that original jazz, you know, ragtime we called it back in those days.
Did they play more ragtime, you think, the New Orleans bands, than you did here?

Oh, yes, sir. I was on the show and practically put me out of business. The business bands did. They'd come over here in the late years, you know, and play that jazz music, you know, which we call ragtime, we played strictly by the music.
Did you ever go to New Orleans yourself when you were younger?
But you used to hear them when they came here?
Yes, they come here, that's right.
